requirements.requirement: The system must define a MongoDB collection schema for cached quality scores including fields for cache_key, entity_type, entity_id, inputs, outputs, version, created_at, and expires_at.
The system must generate a deterministic cache_key derived from normalized input parameters including provider_id or trial_id, location, filters, and weights.
The system must ensure identical input parameter sets always produce the same cache_key.
The system must ensure different input parameter sets produce different cache_keys.
The system must store the full set of normalized input parameters used to generate the cache_key within the cache document.
The system must include a version field in each cache record to support invalidation when scoring logic changes.
The system must include an expires_at timestamp in each cache record to support TTL-based expiration.
The system must configure a MongoDB TTL index on expires_at to automatically remove expired cache entries.
The system must support both provider and clinical trial entities within the same cache schema using an entity_type discriminator.
The system must store computed quality score outputs including overall score and individual measure results in the cache document.
The system must normalize input parameters (e.g., sort filters, standardize casing, remove nulls) before cache_key generation.
The system must reject cache writes if required fields (cache_key, outputs, version, expires_at) are missing.
The system must handle invalid or malformed input parameters by not generating a cache_key and returning an error.
The system must handle MongoDB write failures by surfacing an error without corrupting existing cache records.
